THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

A small food business needs online ordering that is simple for customers and reliable on the back end.

HOW IT WAS BUILT

Approach

Menu served by the API, cart state in a tiny store, checkout through a native <dialog>. Orders flow into the analytics dashboard.

Key features

  • 01Menu API with categories
  • 02Cart drawer with live server quote
  • 03Pickup / delivery and promo codes
  • 04Hand-written canvas 3D carton
